data.narrative:
Tomorrow.io is a Series E-stage space & aerospace company that has raised $385M+ to date. The valuation landscape includes five public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trading at a median 23.9x revenue multiple, alongside eight private peers including SpaceX and Sierra Space, though a narrowly-filtered peer set at identical stage and valuation tier yielded insufficient datapoints for a robust median approach.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable technique. Using the $385M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a standard 1.4x step-up multiplier typical of Series E advancement, the analysis implies a valuation of $539M. Public comparables exist but cannot be anchored without disclosed revenue; the target's private status precludes application of the 23.9x P/S median observed in public Space & Aerospace names.

The triangulated range supports $458M–$620M, centered at $539M. This range reflects a single methodological input and carries material uncertainty. Key risks include: absence of revenue disclosure preventing multiple-based validation; sparse same-stage peer data limiting peer-median precision; and the broad valuation dispersion across public comps (suggesting sector heterogeneity). The $539M midpoint is defensible as a stage-derived floor but would benefit from either disclosed revenue metrics or tighter private peer clustering at equivalent stage and scale.
